_: The authority for what the drain may do unattended. tick.py refuses to emit a brief that would violate this file. Operator decision 2026-09-11.
_repo: Passed to every `gh` call as --repo. It is a POLICY input, never an accident of the working directory: `gh issue list` with no --repo resolves the repo from cwd, so running the harness from another checkout returned rc=0 and a valid-looking list for a DIFFERENT repository - whose numbers are disjoint from this ledger's, which would have moved all 297 items out of the queue in one save.

scope.definition_of_done: every open issue reaches closed | parked | declined

wip._: A policy INPUT, not a constant. The host carries ~66 GB committed before any agent starts (vmmemWSL 48 GB + llama-server ~18 GB), which is why three things were memory-killed on 2026-09-11. Lower this before blaming a command.

stop_and_ask._: Hard refusals. tick.py will not emit a brief containing these, and a lane that reports one must park the item.
stop_and_ask.publish_security_advisory: outward-facing and irreversible; operator decides once the fix is DEPLOYED
stop_and_ask.move_live_acr_tags: a branch dispatch of build-fiab-images-acr-tasks hard-codes --image <name>:latest and moves :latest AND :v0.1 for all 13 images in the live Commercial ACR
stop_and_ask.force_push_shared_branch: a stale worktree makes --force-with-lease unsafe; sweep first
stop_and_ask.weaken_or_baseline_a_guard: making something green by widening its allowlist is the defect, not the fix
stop_and_ask.add_trivyignore_entry: the baseline is deliberately EMPTY; fix the image
stop_and_ask.use_skip_valve: LOOM_BUILD_SKIP_SUPPLY_CHAIN / skip_uat / skip_signature_verify ship unverified or unsigned artifacts

receipts._: Which receipt closes which class of issue. deploy-integrity.md R2: merged is never done.
receipts.g1_assertion_rule: must key on something ONLY a success path can produce, and the receipt must NAME why it is unreachable from an error path. An assertion satisfied by 'Error: HTTP 500' is not a receipt.

verdict_parsing._: merge-gate reads ISSUE COMMENTS, not review events. A verdict registers only if all three hold.
verdict_parsing.note: 'CHANGES REQUIRED' is silently discarded and cost two rounds on 2026-09-11. The token is matched in the order listed, so an approving verdict must not mention a prior block inside the window.

ordering._: Execution order of the workstreams. A later stream may depend on an earlier one, never the reverse.
ordering.W9_reason: 118 issues carry no lane and 153 carry no size; neither can be safely scheduled, so triage gates the parallelism for every other stream

stop_conditions._: Conditions under which the harness halts the whole run rather than continuing.
stop_conditions.deploy_path_red: deploy-integrity R1 - a broken deploy path preempts all feature work; fix it before selecting anything else
stop_conditions.estate_behind_and_not_recovering: R3 - drift is a defect with an owner, not a background condition
stop_conditions.gate_tooling_untracked: a gate nobody can read cannot be trusted to merge; W0 must land first
